title: Patch: the menus' banner offers the way back to a live co-op game

```text
# #1566: Patch: the menus' banner offers the way back to a live co-op game
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

Part of #1576 (the tavern menu overhaul).

Blocked by #1577
Blocked by #1578

It waits for the new main menu (three doors) and the new Play screen, and lands on them: read "the main and practice menus" below as the tavern home and the Play screen (and wherever the practice entry lives after #1578), and the `play.tsx` refusal path as wherever #1578 left it.

## What it actually means
A player who leaves a co-op game mid-match and lands on the main or practice menu gets no banner offering a way back — they have to remember to visit the Play together page, the only place that shows "Back to your co-op game". After this, the same banner that already offers "Rejoin" for a ladder game or a Conquest series appears for a co-op game on the menus, and a lobby refusal that says the player is already in a co-op match links straight back to it.

## Why
`spec/13-duos.md` §13.8: "A player who leaves a co-op game's page may go back to it while it lasts: the menus' banner offers it, as it offers a live match" ([[R765]]). Today `GET /api/auth/me` returns `currentMatchId`/`currentSeriesId` only (`crates/server/src/api/auth.rs:335`) — a co-op match sets no in-match flag — `LiveGame` has no `duos` kind (`apps/web/src/net/liveGame.ts:24`), `LiveGameBanner` covers only match and series (`apps/web/src/routes/GameBanner.tsx:73-98`), and the only way back is `CoopPanel.tsx:224-228` on `/together`, read once on mount. The server already sends `duosMatchId` in an `already_in_match` refusal (`crates/server/src/api/decks.rs:1107-1111`) and `play.tsx` drops it.

## Proposal
Return `currentDuosMatchId` from `/api/auth/me` (the server already answers "is this account in a live co-op match" for `/api/duos/live`); extend `LiveGame` with `kind: "duos"`, a `LIVE_WORDS` entry, and a Rejoin route to `/duos/<id>`; consume `duosMatchId` in `play.tsx`'s refusal path so "finish your co-op match first" becomes a link.

## Where it lands
`crates/server/src/api/auth.rs`, `apps/web/src/net/liveGame.ts`, `apps/web/src/routes/GameBanner.tsx`, `apps/web/src/routes/play.tsx`; spec §13.8, R765.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A player in a live co-op game sees the banner with Rejoin on the main and practice menus; it navigates to `/duos/<id>` and disappears once the game ends
- [ ] An `already_in_match` refusal carrying `duosMatchId` offers a link to the game
- [ ] Server test: `/api/auth/me` reports the co-op match while it lasts and not after
- [ ] Web tests beside `liveGame.test.tsx`/`GameBanner.test.tsx`

## Size and risks
Medium — touches the shared `me` payload and the banner. Adjacent to the open seat-ledger work (#1523/#1557): even if `in_match_id` comes to cover co-op seats, a `duos` kind is still needed so the banner routes to `/duos/` rather than `/match/`; worst case a small rebase.
```
